post.summary: Analyzes a large specification document and extracts a list of proposed User Stories with strict traceability.

document_summary.description: A brief overview of the parsed document's core objective.

proposed_stories.description: List of identified functional chunks to be transformed into User Stories.

story_title.description: Proposed title for the User Story.

traceability_reference.description: Section header, page number, or paragraph ID from the original document indicating where this requirement was found.

source_snippet.description: The exact verbatim text snippet from the document that justifies this story. This isolated text will become the direct prompt input for the 'generate_story' skill.

telemetry.description: Governance metrics for the document breakdown process.

unmapped_sections_count.description: Number of document sections that could not be mapped to a functional story (e.g., vague marketing text or technical noise).

human_review_required.description: True if total_stories > 15 (chunk is too large to process safely) or if unmapped_sections_count is high. Triggers human intervention before proceeding to generation.

200.description: Document successfully broken down into a traceable list of proposed stories.
